snippet.title: Starbug Troopers : The 4 horseflies of the Apocalypse | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Starbug Troopers is a cute and colorful action game blending turn-based strategy and shoot 'em up elements, set in the cute world of insects.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3160110/Starbug_Troopers__The_4_horseflies_of_the_apocalypse/

Developed by Big Loot Games
